ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in circle $O$, $\overset{\frown}{AB} = \overset{\frown}{AC}$. If $\angle B = 70^\circ$, then what is the measure of $\angle A$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that in circle $\odot O$, $\widehat{AB}=\widehat{AC}$ and $\angle B=70^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle C=\angle B=70^\circ$,\\
thus $\angle A=180^\circ-\angle B-\angle C=180^\circ-70^\circ-70^\circ=\boxed{40^\circ}$.
